coverage: Played the running build on :3170 in my own Chromium context (a copy of the app chunk was patched in that context only, to expose the zustand store as window.__stores for fast turns, store edits and submitOrder). Diplomacy screen: every overture, refusals, withdraw and refunds (cash arithmetic checked), grants once/locked/stop/insufficient funds, subsidy, boycott, war question texts, peace, colony tab, relation palette, keyboard, focus, 1280x720 to 390x844. Relations: trade +1 per commodity, pact +10, grants, war -40/-5/-20 checked against FR-168/170 and news lines against the tabs (they agree). Alliance with Valdoria (reached with a cash edit). Council: HUD line and projection every turn, meetings turns 10/20/30/40 on 3 seeds, abstention texts incl. "at war", tie, colony, cell titles, news line reopen, Escape/n key/New game. Winning vote: verified in the UI twice: (a) state edit at turn 10 for Testland and for Valdoria (screens, game-over text, HUD, New game); (b) a real conquest game: an engine-planned order list (war on Arvelia and Valdoria, grants and pact to Pellis) replayed on seed 7 through submitOrder with real Advance Turn clicks, state matching the engine on all 40 turns, ending "Council of Governors: Testland wins with 9 of 12 votes." on turn 40. Also: idle 40-turn games, conquest game over, 60-seed 2400-turn invariant fuzz of diplomacy/council (0 violations), 24-seed AI behaviour scan, repo specs m6-diplomacy, m10-council, m10-qa and 241 related unit tests all pass.
not_covered: Mouse-driven play of the Army and Attack screens (another track; the conquest orders were sent through the store). Only Chromium on Windows; Firefox/WebKit and screen readers not run. Alliance offers from the computer cannot happen, so that Accept Offer variant was not seen. Colony boycott, Join the Empire and pact intervention do not exist in v2. Trade internals (Board of Trade rules) only checked where they change relations or subsidy money.

findings.title: A Council victory cannot be reached by diplomacy; it always needs a war that takes land from Valdoria
repro: Start a new game (Testland, 12 provinces: Testland 4, Valdoria 4, four minors with 1 each; 9 votes needed).

In Diplomacy bring all four minors to Brown, level 6 of 9 or higher with Testland (consulate, embassy, pact, grants, trade) and keep Valdoria below them. (To save time the audit set the relation points to 89 for Testland and 0 for Valdoria with a store edit.)
End turns until the Council screen opens on turn 11 and read the HUD line and the screen.
findings.expected: rules/01 section 4 and NR-011: a nation with the best economy and diplomacy can be elected by more than two thirds of the governors and the game ends; the roadmap calls M10 done with "more than two thirds wins".
findings.actual: Best possible peaceful result: HUD "If it met now: Testland 8, Valdoria 4, abstain 0 of 12; 9 needed"; Council screen "No winner. The Council meets again on turn 20." Own 4 + four minors = 8, one short. Testland and Valdoria provinces do not touch (Arvelia lies between), so a win needs war on Arvelia first and then war on Valdoria. A headless all-in conqueror (war on Arvelia turn 1, on Valdoria turn 3, grants and pact to Pellis) won the Council in 4 of 8 seeds (2, 5, 6, 7), every time only at the turn-40 meeting; seeds 3, 4 and 8 stopped at 8 votes because Pellis stayed at 42 to 44 points, seed 1 at 7 provinces. The same plan replayed in the running app on seed 7 ended with "Council of Governors: Testland wins with 9 of 12 votes." on turn 40. Nothing in the HUD, Diplomacy or Council screen tells the player that peaceful play cannot win.
